description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a 10-person engineering team as its first product engineer, working closely with the CTO in a hybrid New York City role. You will take customer problems from conversation through launch and adoption, combining full-stack engineering with product judgment to shape AI-powered workflows.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Talk with customers, use the product firsthand, and turn ambiguous needs into straightforward solutions.

 - Build full-stack agents and features that connect models with tools, data, and customer-facing interfaces.

 - Develop workflows such as turning campaign briefs into contests and helping creators move from invitation to published content.

 - Test brand and creator experiences end to end, then improve them using customer feedback, usage data, and agent evaluations.

 - Use AI coding tools to work efficiently, verify their output, and collaborate through clear decisions, demos, and code reviews.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Proficiency in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

 - Experience shipping and maintaining products across the frontend and backend, including customer-facing web application features.

 - Experience with APIs and web service design.

 - Experience using AI tools to build agents or AI-powered features.

 - Background in creator marketing or e-commerce is relevant.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $180,000 to $250,000 annually.


LOCATION

Hybrid role based in New York, New York, United States.
